messages:
nate: Who's coming to the playoff hockey watch tonight? TV reserved in the lounge at 7:30. :hockey: :tv:

ivy: I'm in. Bringing a blanket and loud opinions about refs. :eyes:

peter: Will there be shots? Asking for a friend who loves celebratory espresso. :coffee: :sweat_smile:

zoe: I'll bring sparkling water and the Good Luck goalie charm (very scientific). Also trade offer: small trophy for best goalie chant.

nate: FYI goalie curse rules: never compliment a goalie in person before the game. Last time I said "solid wall" and he got yanked in the 2nd. Learned the hard way. :cold_sweat:

ivy: Noted. We will whisper compliments only and do ritual clapping instead.

peter: Quick poll: chant options — "Block that puck!" vs "Safe hands!" React with :one: or :two:

zoe: :two: safer vibes

ivy: :one: more energy

ops-bot: Reminder — lounge booking confirmed 7:30-10:30. Please clean up after. :broom:

nate: Vote outcome: tie. We'll alternate chants by period. Also, if the goalie has a shutout, winner of our mini-pool gets free bagels next day. $3 buy-in.

peter: Added my $3 to @nate IRL. Who's running the mini-pool bracket?

zoe: I'll track it in a tiny spreadsheet and post results. Link after game.

ivy: Audible rule: if someone does the classic compliment, we make them wear the tiny goalie hat for 5 minutes. No exceptions.

nate: Deal. See you all at 7:15 for pre-game trash talk and hat distribution. :hockey_stick_and_puck:
